lessons_learned: Lesson learned: Google Docs NORMAL_TEXT default 36 PT indentFirstLine shifts centered Figure/Table captions and indents flush-left code Listing titles unless indentFirstLine, indentStart, and indentEnd are explicitly set to 0 PT; insert-table adds a 1-char spacer paragraph before the table that breaks keepWithNext and cannot be deleted across the table boundary—copy the caption paragraphStyle onto the spacer paragraph and delete the caption's trailing newline [ei_a-1..ei_a] instead.

Prevention runbook/checklist: Apply updateTableRowStyle (preventOverflow: true) on multi-page reference tables and 1x1 code boxes, size Method columns >= 48 PT so DELETE fits on one line, dump fresh document body JSON immediately before raw index batches, and locate targets dynamically by content rather than hardcoded body offsets.
